# Circuit Trace

> Minimalist Android logic puzzle game by Grounded Studio. 600+ puzzles across 6 level packs, built-in Puzzle Editor with share codes, 6 languages, free on Google Play.

Circuit Trace is a flow-style puzzle game where players connect colored pairs across a grid, restoring circuit paths. The game is designed around calm focus and bite-sized sessions — no energy systems, no interruptions, no dark patterns. Free with ads between campaign levels; optional one-time €3.99 Remove Ads purchase.

## Core Features

- **600+ puzzles** across 6 level packs (100 levels each): Circuit Trace, Classic, Diodes, Portals, Arcade, Labyrinth
- **Labyrinth** (new) — shaped boards (rings, crosses, hearts) with holes inside and walls between cells
- **Difficulty** — every level is rated by a solver that reasons like a human player; boards solvable at a glance are rejected
- **Endless mode** — infinite generated puzzles, 7 difficulty levels from 5×5 to 8×8
- **Expert preview** — random sector 8-9 puzzle for a taste of late-campaign difficulty
- **Daily Challenge** — one new puzzle per day, globally seeded (same for everyone)
- **Weekly Puzzles** — six fresh puzzles per week, Monday-Saturday difficulty ramp
- **Time Trial** — 60-second sprint mode
- **Puzzle Editor + Share Codes** — design 5×5 to 8×8 puzzles with up to 8 colours, diodes, portals, stars and checkpoints, save up to 5 in library, share via short codes (format CT-XXXXX-XXXXX-…) or publish to the in-game Community (New/Top/Mine, likes, reporting)
- **Google Play Games Services** — 23 achievements, 3 leaderboards (Daily, Time Trial, Endless), cloud save
- **6 languages**: English, Nederlands, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português
- **Interactive hint system** — shows the full next line of the last-touched colour
- **Tutorial demo** — walks new players through the mechanics before their first solve
- **In-App Review** — rating prompt integrated via Google Play In-App Review API

## Technical

- Platform: Android 8.0+
- Package ID: com.game.circuittrace
- Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.game.circuittrace
- Studio: Grounded Studio (https://grounded-studio.app)
- Game engine: Godot 4.7
- Offline-capable, cloud save optional (via Play Games sign-in)
- No tracking cookies, no dark patterns
